title: BillFlow AI
tagline: An explainable finance operating system that plans bills, protects a safety reserve and keeps payment authorization human-controlled.
problem: Traditional trackers describe past spending but do not safely coordinate upcoming bills, subscriptions and competing cash-flow deadlines.
solution: SafePay forecasts liquidity, ranks payment timing and funding sources, explains every recommendation, and synchronizes sandbox provider states after explicit authorization.
evidence: a FastAPI and React vertical slice with JWT/Google authentication, PostgreSQL support, deterministic provider connectors, audit events, PDF receipts and automated tests.

title: OmniCalc + CalcGraph
tagline: A natural-language calculation workspace that compiles requests into verified, deterministic calculation graphs.
problem: LLM-generated calculations can be persuasive but unverifiable, unsafe and difficult to reproduce.
solution: CalcGraph uses a typed intermediate representation, static verification, allowlisted formulas and evidence receipts before accepting any result.
evidence: React and FastAPI workspaces, secure JWT and Google sign-in, PostgreSQL history, reproducibility receipts, Docker production checks and a benchmark harness.

title: Quick Hire
tagline: A role-based recruitment platform connecting job seekers and recruiters through focused workflows.
problem: Disconnected hiring workflows make it harder for candidates to track applications and recruiters to manage opportunities and applicants.
solution: Separate job-seeker and recruiter experiences support profiles, job listings, applications, tracking and personalized recommendations.
evidence: an end-to-end database-backed application with role-specific dashboards, authentication and practical recruitment workflows.

title: BloomSense AI
tagline: A multimodal flower identification experience using image detection, botanical context, translation and voice output.
problem: Species identification tools often return only a label and are difficult to use across input modes or languages.
solution: Camera, upload and voice workflows combine YOLOv8, PlantNet and contextual APIs with confidence, history and spoken results.
evidence: a FastAPI REST backend, responsive browser interface, multi-mode detection, 18-language translation and accessible text-to-speech.

title: Mental Health Data Analysis
tagline: A model-comparison and exploratory-analysis project for understanding patterns in mental-health data.
problem: Health datasets require careful preparation, interpretable exploration and responsible comparison before drawing conclusions.
solution: The project applies cleaning, visualization and supervised model comparison while keeping the analysis separate from medical diagnosis.
evidence: a reproducible analytics workflow using SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost and visual storytelling.

title: Flower Detection System
tagline: A real-time flower-detection and classification workflow built around a YOLOv8 vision pipeline.
problem: Image classification alone does not localize multiple visual objects or provide an interactive inference experience.
solution: A browser-facing Flask application runs detection, returns annotated results and connects the model to an accessible UI.
evidence: a complete computer-vision pipeline spanning dataset configuration, inference, API integration and application delivery.
